english.title: Supply regulated substance to member of public without entering / causing to enter transaction details onto licence
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) supplied a regulated substance, namely **(..SPECIFY SUBSTANCE..), to a member of the general public without first entering details of the transaction or causing details of the transaction to be entered in the

(A)_[licence_]
(B)_[recognised non-GB licence]_

of the member of the general public
english.legislation: Contrary to section 3A(3) and 8(2) of the Poisons Act 1972.

english.notes:
(i) See section 2 which gives the meaning of a regulated substance.
(ii) A person does not commit an offence under subsection (3) if the requirements of that subsection do not apply to the person's case by virtue of regulations made under section 9B.
(iii) See section section 7A which gives the defence of proof of lack of knowledge.

welsh.welshlegislation: Yn groes i adran 3A(3) ac 8(2) Deddf Gwenwynau 1972.

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level two on the standard scale.

Time limit for prosecutions:
As per section 8(7) - proceedings may be commenced at any time -
(a) within the period of 12 months next after the date of commission of the offence, or
(b) in the case of proceedings instituted by, or by the direction of, the Secretary of State, within the later to end of -
(i) that 12-month period, and (ii) the period of 3 months next after the date on which evidence sufficient in the Secretary of State's opinion to justify a prosecution for the offence comes to the Secretary of State's knowledge
